an3.94:1.1: tamagataṁ → tamaṁ (sya-all) | abbhussakkamāno → abbhosasukkamāno (bj: machasaṁ) | abbhussakkamāno → abbhussukkamāno (cck: sī. pī.)

an3.94:3.3: tasmiñce → tasmiṁ (bj); tasmiṁ ce (cck, sya-all) | saṁyojanaṁ → saññojanaṁ (bj, sya-all) | saṁyojanena saṁyutto → saññojanena saññutto (bj) | saṁyojanena → saññojanena (sya-all) | taṁ → tassa (cck: ka.) | imaṁ → punayimaṁ (cck: syā. kaṁ. ka.)
